description: Which auto-reply would answer a comment, what it would say and why, without sending anything. Pass the comment's text, and post_id for rules on one post. Use it after reply_rule_create or reply_rule_update to check keywords, exclusions and texts.

account_id.description: Defaults to the workspace's only account that takes comment answers

post_id.description: The post the comment is on (rules for one post only answer there)

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: reply_rule_test
title: Try an auto-reply
